notes.title: Gamma Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Overhauled Tutorial System[/h1]
One of the problems that I wanted to fix was to ensure that players had enough practice with rhythmic spellcasting before they fought their first boss. I overhauled the tutorial system in order to provide players with an initial challenge of executing spells at a high Spell-Multiplier. I noticed that many players would spam spell combos as a way to brute force their way through the first bosses, but as the rounds progressed the difficulty of future bosses would be insurmountable. I hope having practiced at the beginning with the rhythm interface will allow players to be proficient when it comes to juggling movement, combat, and rhythm all at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/a9c05f1c56fe5864a2ca8a495ee11df33e6184d3.png[/img]

[h1]Improved Difficulty System[/h1]
There are now two difficulty modes; Normal and Insane. The Insane difficulty mode is the same difficulty that the original game came with. So if you liked the original difficulty, then choose this mode. Otherwise, the Normal difficulty mode was designed to still be challenging, but with a more forgiving system.

In Normal difficulty, the Spell Multiplier reduction when mistiming spells is not significant. Your Spell Multiplier grows much quicker, the rhythm timings of spell combos are slower, and the timing window of combo inputs are more lenient. The amount of damage received is greatly reduced and the amount of health gained through healing is increased. Most enemies also heal themselves at a reduced rate.

[h1]New Bosses[/h1]
[h2]Replaced The Level 1 Boss[/h2]
I replaced the level one boss with the following character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/d89ae13f6e1a309d578eefc1d9006392254f55d7.png[/img]

[h2]Added the Rodent Boss[/h2]
The Rodent is a mechanical boss that spits fire.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/cfda74d4f0fd74bf6095bc0c5bccfd1a4383ba43.png[/img]

[h2]Added the Ice Queen Boss[/h2]
The Ice Queen has a powerful dash attack. Be careful to avoid the ice cubes she leaves behind.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/c72ff4865d8482b437198ca5f4444bd4e0806320.png[/img]

[h1]Closing Remarks[/h1]
For those of you who have played Spell Beats, I want to say thank you for your support so far. It has been a fun learning experience. I hope to keep improving, and I welcome critical feedback. Thanks. :)

notes.title: Removed BPM UI and Improved Terra's Movement & Animation
notes.notes:
Changes
[olist]
[*] Removed BPU UI - The BPM UI added an extra layer of complexity to gameplay that required players to attend to the enemy, the spell rhythm UI, and the BPM UI. In addition, it would require a significant amount of development work to ensure syncing with the music bpm. The framework of code still remains and it should be easy to restart there is interest for it. The music will not be removed and it will remain along with how each spell and key icon path press affects it.
[*] Improved Terra's Movement, Attacks, & Animation - There were major issues with how the animation would hitch upon changing positions and orientations. I fixed the blueprints to smooth the animation. Additionally, I also updated Terra's attack power so that she is much more threatening.
[/olist]

notes.title: Darkness, Shogun, Terra, and Muriel.
notes.notes:
[h1]Dark Mode[/h1]
Updated the map to have a nighttime setting and to be responsive to auto exposure. These changes increases the contrast between dark and light patterns. The spell particle effects are now more prominent and stand out better against the background.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/a17bc8d7ea6ca37ac75dcc97fa64c113851a37c2.png[/img]

[h1]Muriel[/h1]
Added Muriel from Paragon as the second last boss. Muriel is very difficult to battle against. She is fast and powerful. Watch out for her hammer throws. Despite her speed and power, Muriel is still just a stepping stone to the threat of the final boss. I can't wait to see someone get that far.

[h1]Shogun[/h1]
Added the Shogun skin from a Paragon character as the level 9 boss. Watch out for her fast melee slices. Shogun is a great starter boss to introduce players to learn the spell timings and to begin mastering spellcasting.

notes.title: New Spell UI
notes.notes:
This change is intended to simplify the Spell and BPM user interfaces by switching how the timing transformations work. Before, the spell icons would move across the screen from right to left, and now they are rotating and scaling up without translation offsets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/d43467990a85f2c6f4e03827e2cf7dde06e435a2.png[/img]

Changes:
[olist]
[*] New BPM UI - Scales up from a center in circular fashion. This is now located near the bottom middle of the screen above the health and stamina bars.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/9e1a481c87290fc2e465ede50d855b9795ab46ad.png[/img]
[*] New Spell Timing UI - Spell icons are now rotate into alignment and scale from nothing to 100% scaling.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/3de9eeb086dc3cc1447bed3c6eaf41757df87a1e.png[/img]
[*] Increased the spell icon intervals for the punch spells.
[*] Update the spell icon intervals for the elemental spells to be more consistent in length. 
[/olist]

Players can now rely more on their peripheral vision for timing button inputs. This is important since it makes it easier to focus on the enemy and your input timing at the same time. In addition, all these changes save some screen space since they no longer require the translation space.

notes.title: Spell UI Rework
notes.notes: Updated the Spell User Interface from a translation interface of icons to a rotation and scale interface for icons. Also updated the BPM UI to be a circular expander, rather than a translation tick.

notes.title: Music Integration (Phase 1)
notes.notes:
I decided to add music integrated into Spell Beats, but it works a little differently than the usual rhythm game. Normally the musical beat dictates the pace and when the user should respond. In our case this will only be generating spell boosts such as damage, stamina, or heal boosts. The key difference is that the spell input sequences will now modify how the music sounds. For example, the keyboard sequence of right, right will now adjust the equalization levels temporarily. It is now more like how a DJ modifies their tracks, except in our case the modification is minimal. As development continues I will improve upon the complexity of the what players can do.

Major Changes:
[olist]
[*] Slow Time Spell - Slows down time (Max 5 Uses Per Battle). Time is slowed more the better your sequence input timing is. Music is also slowed by this spell.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/738bbb8aafbc2fc82ef39baa889df5e28124474a.png[/img]
[*] Repeater Spell - Repeats the effect of the last healing or damaging spell used (Max 5 Uses Per Battle). The better your input sequence timing the more repetitions that will occur. Music is also repeated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/0dfc037d93091eb8c593c9a5b507c6554b346a9f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/be6f59c9f4654e9d922d4749b265f4e6ea55100e.png[/img]
[*] BPM UI - There is a musical bpm ticker UI at the bottom left of the screen. Players must match the impacts or the casting of their spells with the yellow strip in order to gain spell boosts. Currently the bpm is not synced with the bpm of the music playing. This will be done as part of the future music integration work during Early Access development.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/f35a8db9fe4ffe58d2b6636880b4b3a2c747b737.png[/img]
[*] Engine Upgrade - There is  some missing audio functionality in the previous engine version.  With the upgrade, I was able to introduce some of the equalization changes that sequence inputs do.
[*] Sequence Input Music Modifiers - The button combos that players' input now affect how the music sounds. Some buttons temporarily cause the frequency, bands, or gain of the music to increase or decrease, whereas others adjust the apply a temporary low or high pass filter to the music. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Auto Save System
notes.notes:
Added an auto-save feature that saves at the start of every new level, but it only saves the highest level reached. Use the Continue button to continue from the highest level you reached and New Game to start from the beginning. It does not save progress part way through a level. You must always start at the beginning of the highest level reached when continuing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/4cf24b0df6ac742f22b3fd8abfa5b79be8b82b15.png[/img]

Any feedback would be greatly appreciated.

--Garett
